title: Project procurement legislative framework
description: In this course students will expertise in navigating the project procurement legislative framework.
longDescription: The Professional Certificate Course in Project Procurement Legislative Framework provides learners with a comprehensive understanding of the procurement legal framework, its components, and examples of legal framework requirements. This course also covers the meaning and types of public procurement directives, as well as the tender process and its evaluation. By the end of the course, learners will have a solid grasp of procurement laws and regulations that govern the acquisition of goods and services.
